study: USDA ARS Greeley, Colorado, 2012–2013; one site; randomized treatments within blocks
retrospective: Source metadata and example rows were inspected before protocol; not preregistered.
design: Four block-paired observations per treatment per year; block is plot-letter plus first plot digit.
interpretation: Percentages denote target ET replacement during late vegetative / grain-filling periods, not 75% of total water.
yield: Grain kg/ha at 15.5% moisture for treatment contrasts; dry mass is 0.845 times standard-moisture yield.
statistics: Within-year paired block differences; t interval with 3 degrees of freedom; exact two-sided sign randomization; Holm adjustment over four comparisons. Descriptive two-year study, not a new field recommendation.
state_transfer: Fit harvest index through origin and a one-feature Ridge on 2012 observed dry biomass and dry grain; evaluate 2013 plot observations. The biomass is measured at harvest; this is conditional state-to-yield transfer, not an early forecast or full process-model validation.
caveat: One site and two years; 2013 already in archived source. Replicated plots are not independent sites or years. No cultivar or planting date contrast is evaluated.
